$doc: Template for the /seo scorecard (mode C). Copy to the project (scripts/seo/scorecard.config.json, or anywhere the repo doesn't ignore — pass --config), then: set base, replace samples with one real URL per template, tune thresholds to ~today's numbers so improvements show, and add project-specific guardrails from its cost/infra rules. Live checks fetch the deployed site as Googlebot; static checks run against the working tree. Guardrail failure = REVERT, always.

staticChecks.$note: Cost guardrail — no cache window may shrink vs the base ref, no crawlable page may go force-dynamic. Ships with the skill.
staticChecks.name: no cache window shortened vs origin/main; no force-dynamic on crawlable pages

staticChecks.$note: Replace with the project's own robots invariant (blocked scraper bots, allowed AI bots…).
staticChecks.name: robots keeps its scraper/AI-bot policy

staticChecks.$note: Image optimizer must stay an explicit allowlist (open proxy = cost + SSRF).
staticChecks.name: no wildcard image host
